statement: Intel guides third-quarter 2026 revenue to $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion
why: Guidance centred above the quarter just reported points to continued, if unspectacular, growth.

impact.mechanism: A guided range straddling and exceeding the reported quarter implies order coverage for the next period across CPU, ASIC and foundry work.

evidence.excerpt: third-quarter 2026 revenue of $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion

confidence.basis: Company guidance stated in the primary earnings release; given as a range rather than a point.
